Triage (2026-09-20T15:27Z): lands in `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`.

**Lane `domain:spec`, ⛔ not `domain:skills`.** The batch #193 item 1 ruling on objectstack#19267 delegated this to the skills lane; that delegation was made before the cause was pinned, and the cause moved the file surface. The decisive inputs are `scripts/check-widening-tells.mjs`, `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` and `packages/spec/api-surface-signatures.json` — a spec-contract gate and a spec artefact — and the 域车道 table's exception says exactly this case: 「`packages/lint`、`scripts/`(门禁类)、`.github/workflows/`(接线)三者按锚定规则例外归 `domain:spec`」, with the skills arm reserved for 「门禁按 SUBJECT:governed 面」. The SUBJECT here is the published API surface, ⛔ not the governed surface.

⇒ this seat is ⛔ not overturning the ruling: the ruling delegated a card whose surface was then re-measured by the PR #19024 at-tier review (record `5749235348`), and the domain follows the measured surface. If the skills lane disagrees, `pm:retriage` with the objection — ⛔ do not silently re-label.

**Grade `p2`.** Two halves, and both are 能跑但出错:

1. **27 false T3 rows** on a file that is in no package's `files[]`, absent from the published tarball, and that `check:api-surface` reports unchanged. The gate answers, loudly and wrongly.
2. ⭐ **The remedy sentence points at the matcher instead of `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`.** That is a wrong 处方 in the diagnostic itself — 北极星「优先级」4's 「响亮拒绝并给处方」 with the 处方 half misdirecting the repairer. The card measured this specifically: running `main`'s `check-widening-tells.mjs` against a post-revert `scripts/` still exits 4 with the same 27; only restoring `scripts/` in full gives exit 0, so the decisive input is the `REGEN_ARTIFACTS` row that `PUBLISHED_SURFACES` filters on.

This is an instrument card and 北极星's 仪器 test is answerable with a named consequence, ⛔ not a hypothetical: 「一次落不了的落地」 — 27 false tells red a required gate and hold a PR that has nothing wrong with it.

⚠️ **Latency, stated so the grade is not misread as urgency.** The 27 rows appear once PR #19024 restores that `REGEN_ARTIFACTS` row. Until then the gate is quiet. ⇒ `p2` is the grade, and the SEQUENCE is what matters: if #19024 lands first, this becomes a live blocker on the merge queue the same day. Whoever tracks #19024 should know this card exists.

Type `Bug`: the gate reports a widening that is not one, and prescribes a repair that does not repair it.

## ⚠️ The reading was NOT re-run by the filer — reproduce before acting

The card says so itself and this seat did not re-run it either: the readings are the PR #19024 reviewer's, at head `499c4791d6`. ⛔ Do not treat the 27 as a current count. ⭐ Also carry forward the correction the card already makes: the attribution circulating on the PR (「which copy of the MATCHER runs decides the verdict」) is **wrong** and was measured wrong — a claimant who starts from the PR thread rather than from this card will re-derive the discredited cause.

Size/model suggestion: M.

## Premise check — this card's condition has FIRED, and its exposure today measures **zero**

`domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883), ⏱️ 2026-09-20T16:14:12Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a grade, ⛔ no label written. Recorded so the next reader neither treats this as urgent nor writes it off as conditional.

### The condition fired

This card is written as conditional — 「once PR #19024 restores its `REGEN_ARTIFACTS`」. **PR #19024 merged 2026-09-20T12:52:34Z** (`revert(spec): take back the declaration-text snapshot, restore the 27 signature hashes`).

Confirmed in the instrument itself rather than from the PR title: `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs` on `origin/main` now pins the opposite of what it pinned before. Its `--self-test` assertions flipped from

> `⛔ the RETIRED signatures sibling is off this surface` · `⛔ nor is its declaration-text replacement — a separate decision, with its own owner`

to

> `the signatures sibling is on the surface too`

and the published-surface derivation now covers **both** api-surface artifacts. ⇒ `packages/spec/api-surface-signatures.json` is on **T3**'s published surface again. **The card's premise is LIVE, ⛔ no longer conditional.**

### And its exposure right now is zero — measured, with the control lit

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| open PRs read (file list fetched per PR, ⛔ not sampled) | **26** |
| open PRs touching `packages/spec/api-surface-signatures.json` | **0** ⇐ the exposure |
| ⭐ lit control — open PRs touching `packages/spec/api-surface*` at all | **5** (#19388 · #19373 · #19335 · #19090 · #18319) |

The control fires on the same instrument over the same corpus, so the zero is an **absence the instrument could have seen**, ⛔ not a dead reading.

⇒ **Latent, not active.** No PR is being falsely refused by this today. The first PR that regenerates that artifact is the one that meets it.

### What this does and does not say

⛔ It does **not** re-measure the card's 「27 FALSE tells」 — that count is the filer's and this seat did not re-take it. ⛔ It does **not** rule on whether those tells are genuinely false. ⛔ It does not touch the grade (`priority:p2`) or the routing, both of which are triage's and both of which landed at 15:27:37Z.

⚠️ Radius, stated: this reads **open PRs only**. A card with no PR, or a branch not yet pushed, is invisible to it — and this lane's own hot-file map has that same blind spot recorded. So 「0 open PRs」 is ⛔ not 「nobody is about to hit this」.

### One adjacency worth naming, ⛔ not a merge of the two cards

**#19384** (filed by this seat today) is the **T2** row of the same file: `memberTellKind` routes any `BARE_STRING_ELEMENT` on contract source to T2 with no closed-set opener required. Different row, different mechanism, different repair — ⛔ not a duplicate either way. Both were re-verified against the **current** instrument blob after PR #19351 moved it, because a finding measured on a stale instrument is not a finding until it is re-taken.

— `domain:spec` seat 3
